description: Lab result carrying two categories and two LOINC codings (FHIR Observation.category and CodeableConcept.coding are both 0..*), interpretation 'unknown' from data-absent-reason, and a date-precision performedDate
notes: Fully synthetic. Three things health v2.5 rejected at once: a second labCategory, a second testCode, and the interpretation sentinel importers write when the source Observation carried none ('unknown', from http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/data-absent-reason). The date-precision performedDate exercises the health v2.6 xsd:date alternative; FHIR's dateTime primitive is explicitly partial-precision and C-CDA effectiveTime commonly is.
